title: Maintaining Correct Drain Pipe Slope to Prevent Clogs
description: Proper slope on horizontal drainage piping ensures that liquids and solids travel together without separation. If a pipe lacks sufficient slope, flow velocity drops, causing heavy solids to settle along the pipe bottom and form blockages over time. Conversely, excessive pitch can cause liquids to flow faster than solid waste, leaving debris behind in horizontal runs. Regular inspection of pipe supports and hangers prevents pipe sagging or bellies that trap standing water. Maintaining steady, code-compliant pitch and secure strapping preserves self-cleansing velocity throughout the DWV system.

Maintaining Correct Drain Pipe Slope to Prevent Clogs

Proper slope on horizontal drainage piping ensures that liquids and solids travel together without separation. If a pipe lacks sufficient slope, flow velocity drops, causing heavy solids to settle along the pipe bottom and form blockages over time. Conversely, excessive pitch can cause liquids to flow faster than solid waste, leaving debris behind in horizontal runs. Regular inspection of pipe supports and hangers prevents pipe sagging or bellies that trap standing water. Maintaining steady, code-compliant pitch and secure strapping preserves self-cleansing velocity throughout the DWV system.
